scripts.publish-all: bun clean && bun run build && lerna publish --force-publish --no-private
scripts.publish-dry-run: bun clean && bun run build && bunx lerna version --no-git-tag-version --no-push --force-publish --no-private
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun --cwd apps/e2e e2e
scripts.test:e2e:retry: bun run build && bun --cwd apps/e2e e2e:retry
scripts.test:e2e:client: bun run build && bun --cwd apps/e2e e2e:client
scripts.test:e2e:engine: bun run build && bun --cwd apps/e2e e2e:engine
scripts.test:e2e:indexer: bun run build && bun --cwd apps/e2e e2e:indexer
scripts.test:e2e:trigger: bun run build && bun --cwd apps/e2e e2e:trigger
scripts.test:e2e:mobile: bun run build && bun --cwd apps/e2e e2e:mobile
